_regression.source: hamletgen cohort seed 2 at a43c955, before the drain_heading span fix (sink.py)
_regression.why: The placer read the drain collector's heading off its FINAL VERTEX PAIR while drainage_junction_smooth reads the same corner over a 40 px chord; on this fan the two disagreed by 76.1 deg, so the search elected a brook that runs 1,100 px UPHILL, 147.9 deg off the fall, back across the dry plots. Fixed by GATE_FLOW_SPAN in hamletgen/sink.py plus descent/divergence terms in the offmap route score.
_regression.note: The manifest is a43c955-era, so under the CURRENT gate it also fires three checks that have nothing to do with this defect (woodland_commons_visibly_stocked, paddy_plot_seams_shared, paddy_plots_are_workable_basins) - rules the engine gained after that commit. The replay is targeted on `fires`, so they never run; they are recorded here so a reader who gates the file by hand does not mistake them for part of the finding.
